blocks.text: As Regine Velasquez capped her career milestone with her “Finale” concert, Ogie Alcasid on Sunday night heaped praises on his wife, calling her the “greatest singer of this beloved country.” On the second night of her concert series at the SM Mall of Asia Arena, Alcasid was again a special guest where he performed with Velasquez their popular duet, “Ikaw Lamang (Hanggang Ngayon).” The song was written by Alcasid for Velasquez and became the official soundtrack of Velasquez’s 2002 movie with Richard Gomez. After their performance, the singer-songwriter told the Asia’s Songbird that he forgot to tell her something during his […]...
